dispositions.method: Round two of 1783. The sweep check of 24 and 25 November 2026 (X-THIN-SWEEP; outputs/story_discovery_1779/sweep_check_25nov.md) read every passage of the 1783 pages shared word for word by 4 or more papers that no counted opening of round one explains, looked each up in the year's lists and counted it by its own opening words against every page of the year in both transcriptions. It found one item printed by every paper that survives for its weeks, which round one's lists did not name; asked, the owner chose on 25 November 2026 to admit it as the rule reads. Every printing was checked against its page scan by AI reviewers (scan_batches/round2.json, SCAN_PROTOCOL.md; verdicts in scan_verdicts/round2*.json).
dispositions.selection_rule: As in round one (Y-THIN as amended, B1): an item printed by every newspaper that survives for its weeks is admitted. The New York paragraph of 23 July is printed by all 4 papers of its weeks, one of them in part (C-02).

counted_item_by_item.The New York report of the brig Lucy and: 4 of the 4 papers that survive for its weeks (PP 26 July, CC 5 August, SCG 6 August, NHG 9 August); by its opening (the brig Lucy) 3 of 4, and the New-Hampshire Gazette prints only its part on the frigate Mercury, under the same date 'July 23.', counted with the others as an abridged print (C-02).
